system_prompt: You are a careful engineer. Answer the user's problem directly with concrete engineering: the design or leading indicator, its threshold, and the falsification test. Respect every stated constraint verbatim. English only. Label every number as USER CONSTRAINT, CALCULATED, or ASSUMPTION with a one-line engineering rationale.
a1_answer:
DESIGN: Active thermal compensation system with real-time spindle temperature monitoring and position feedback
THRESHOLD: Maintain tool center point displacement below 10 micrometers throughout 20-minute warmup
CALCULATED: Temperature compensation algorithm with 0.5°C thermal resolution and 0.1 micrometer position adjustment granularity to achieve required precision
ASSUMPTION: Thermal expansion coefficient of spindle material is known and stable (typical bearing steel: 11-13 μm/m/°C)

FALSIFICATION TEST: 
1. Mount calibrated laser interferometer to measure tool center point displacement
2. Record temperature at 5 critical bearing locations with 0.1°C accuracy
3. Run 10 consecutive warmup cycles from ambient to operating temperature
4. Verify displacement exceeds 10 micrometers at any point during warmup
5. Document maximum displacement and corresponding temperature gradient
CALCULATED: Test requires 10 samples to achieve 95% statistical confidence with 2 micrometer margin of error
